Six of seven changed lines keep; the timber answer was changed to answer yes or no directly, fix applied in the post and entry regenerated; the final wording was not re-reviewed. Cannibalisation: clean; highest overlap for the post 3.72%; no pair above 40% that was not above 40% before (Thermo Premium and Thermo Prime 45.9%).
Live AI test, logged out: ChatGPT 13 of 15, DuckDuckGo Search Assist 6, Google AI Mode 6, Gemini 3; Perplexity and Copilot app need an account. Google AI Mode still says SR3 equals RC3 citing steelr.co.uk (old wording). Visibility organic capture failed twice and is not measured.
